## Change
State the behavior changed and why, with linked issues.

Closes #

## Evidence
- [ ] Tested clean configuration/build on affected platforms
- [ ] Added or updated tests that fail before the fix
- [ ] Verified boundary, negative and failure-path behavior
- [ ] Recorded commands/results and relevant artifacts
- [ ] Updated affected architecture/behavior documentation

## Review risks
Identify state ownership, data flow, timing, concurrency, memory safety or compatibility risks that this change affects. Explain any nonapplicable checks.

## Release impact
Document user-visible behavior, configuration/asset changes and migration or rollback needs.

Do not merge with failing required CI, unresolved actionable review findings or unsupported accuracy claims.
